plan.goal: Make cross-session/cross-model drift structurally low instead of accidentally low: the normative clause of a decision survives every render surface verbatim (never clipped, never aged out), gets re-surfaced at the point of use, and — where expressible as a predicate — is mechanically enforced. Engine-side only; certification (A3 trap harness, cross-model arms, n>=150) is handoff-bench machinery outside this repo. Evidence base: C-abl ablation showed decisions are load-bearing; live digest shows 90/280-char clips cutting operative detail; MAX_DECISIONS=5 ages settled decisions out.

tasks.title: Schema: optional `rule` (short imperative, verbatim-render contract) on decision_logged payload + LogDecisionArgs; SPEC contract updated
Fold: DecisionState carries rule; tests for payload validation + fold
Digest: Standing constraints section — every decision with a rule, verbatim; budget pressure drops whole entries with a count pointer, never clips inside a rule; immune to the last-5 window
Full status view + decisions.md projection render rule ahead of chose/over/because
Digest instructs the resuming session to restate goal + next action + applicable constraints before acting; test
sofar_update_task (-> active) response carries the standing rules, budgeted — reminder at point of use beats instructions at session start; test
Design: guard predicate shape (glob/grep over touched files + commands, zero model calls) — log decision before building
Doctor + Stop-gate check session events against guards; violation names the decision
Tests: guard match/no-match, doctor axis, gate surface

payload.because: C-abl (handoff-bench R04) showed decisions are the load-bearing field, and the live digest clips exactly them (over@90, decision line@280, last-5 aging). Raising budgets just moves the cliff; a new event type forks fold/render/doctor for the same semantic. An optional field keeps 0.21.0 logs valid (unknown fields already tolerated), and 'has an imperative worth verbatim rendering' is precisely the standing-constraint distinction.
payload.chose: `rule` as an optional field on decision_logged — a short imperative clause whose presence IS what makes a decision a standing constraint (one field, one concept; render contract: verbatim, never clipped, never aged out)
payload.over: a separate standing:bool flag, a new event type, or raising the existing clip budgets
